page: Microsoft Azure NV36ads_A10_v5 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine powered by an AMD x86_64 processor platform under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration provides 36 dedicated vCPUs paired with 440.0 GB of system memory, delivering a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.22 GB per vCPU. Networking does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Hardware acceleration is provided by a single integrated NVIDIA A10 GPU with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance includes 1,546 GB of local SSD scratch storage and supports Premium Storage configurations for scalable persistent disk access.

With balanced compute cores, an elevated RAM capacity, dedicated local SSD capacity, and tensor-capable GPU hardware, the NV36ads_A10_v5 is engineered for graphics rendering, virtual desktop workstations, batch inference, video encoding, and data analytics pipelines requiring large in-memory caches.
